title: Pull request
no_gh: gh isn't installed on this computer: install it and sign in to see the pull request here
not_signed_in: gh isn't signed in on this computer (gh auth login)
none: This branch has no pull request yet
push_first: Push the branch first, then open a pull request
gone: This branch has no pull request
hand_hint: Adds it to the message box as a comment: it goes to the agent with your next message
handed_all_one: {count} review comment added to the message
handed_all_other: {count} review comments added to the message
thread_note: A review comment on pull request #{number} at {where}: please address it.
thread_note_outdated: A review comment on pull request #{number} at {where} (that code has changed since): please check whether it still applies and address it.
draft_no_merge: A draft: mark it ready for review on GitHub before merging
conflict: It conflicts with {base}: resolve that first
not_ready: Not mergeable yet: its checks or reviews are still needed. It can merge by itself once they pass.
auto_waiting: Set to merge by itself once its checks and reviews pass
auto_set: It merges once its checks and reviews pass
auto_cleared: It no longer merges by itself
auto_confirm: Once its checks and reviews pass, GitHub merges it into {base} ({method}) without asking again.
auto_off_confirm: It stays open; nothing merges until you merge it.
keeps_branch: {branch} is kept, here and on GitHub.
create_confirm: A pull request from {branch} into {base} is opened on GitHub; everyone who can see the repository sees it.
create_confirm_draft: A draft pull request from {branch} into {base} is opened on GitHub; everyone who can see the repository sees it.
